fact: A blue giant and one of the two bright 'Pointers' aiming at the Southern Cross.
bio: Hadar (Beta Centauri), also called Agena, is a hot blue system of massive stars around 390 light-years away, the eleventh-brightest in the sky. Together with nearby Rigil Kentaurus it forms the Southern Pointers that lead the eye to the Southern Cross.
cultural: Its traditional name derives from Arabic. As a brilliant southern beacon it has long served navigators below the equator, and it appears alongside the Cross in the sky-lore of many southern cultures.
